_comment: Expected page IDs for tests/fixtures/v7_control_plane/. Computed via _page_id._stable_page_id(relative, topic_id) using hashlib.md5(relative.encode()).hexdigest()[:8] + '-' + _slugify(source_stem)[:32] + '-' + hashlib.md5(topic_id.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]. Updated 2026-09-19 for the D7 fix (the topic discriminator moved out of the truncated slug budget). Only md5_prefix is consumed by tests; expected_topic_slugs is descriptive and predates the D7 fix.
test_invariants: source_a.md topic 'writing-techniques' and source_b.md topic 'writing-techniques' produce different page_ids (different md5 prefix)
page_id format (2026-09-19, D7 fix): <8-hex source md5>-<slug of source stem, <=32 chars>-<8-hex topic md5>
page_id never contains path separators or '..'
page_id length is bounded (<= 50 chars) so it is safe as a filename component
page_id stable across Windows (raw\sources\x) and POSIX (raw/sources/x) given the same logical relative path
two different topics of one source always produce different page_ids (the D7 regression: they used to collapse to one id and the later page silently overwrote the earlier)
